relationships.subject: VX-548
relationships.evidence_quote: VX-548 is a new oral NaV1.8-specific inhibitor that received United States Food and Drug Administration Fast Track and Breakthrough Therapy designations.

relationships.subject: VX-548
relationships.evidence_quote: These showed that VX-548, when given as an oral loading dose of 100 mg followed by 50 mg 12-hly, significantly decreased pain scores compared with placebo.

key_findings: Oral NaV1.8 inhibitor VX-548 reduced pain scores versus placebo in Phase II and III trials but not versus hydrocodone-acetaminophen.
Long-term safety is uncertain; high-dose 12-week use in diabetic neuropathy decreased creatinine clearance.
